title: Fasten a bra’s back hooks on a torso form
instruction: Fasten both back hooks of the bra in the outermost eye row and leave the band untwisted and securely closed on the torso form.
context: Fastening a bra requires holding two elastic fabric ends under tension while engaging small ungated hooks. This task isolates that part of dressing assistance.
setup: A fixed torso form wears a prepared bra with 32 mm-wide reinforced closure tapes, two ungated metal hooks and three eye rows. The non-working garment is supported on the form; two 83 mm elastic working wings end in loose tapes, initially 80 mm apart. Hook spacing is 16 mm and wire diameter 0.8 mm. Both arms use 40 x 6 x 1 mm finger extensions with a 4 N jaw limit. Fixed dimensions and layout are in the README and geometry.py.
scoring: Damage or a twisted band gives 0. Otherwise, after both hands are at least 55 mm clear with open fingers for 3 seconds: 0.5 if at least one hook remains in its outer-row eye throughout; 1.0 if both do. No credit for a closure still held by the robot. Highest qualifying score applies.
fidelity: Native elastic end links represent the working wings; the non-working garment is supported on the form. Intermediate ribbons are visual: distributed cloth contact and wrinkles are omitted. Reinforced tapes, hooks and eyes have native collision, with no auto-latch. Contact-checked finite finger joints approximate pinch friction. Elastic overload, twist, slip and failed retention lose credit.
